full_text:
PoCSC Presents:
The People of Color
Sustainability Collective
Professional
Development Symposium
Date
October 28th 2026
RSVP HERE
Time and
Place
5:00pm to 7:30pm at
the University Center, in
the Alumni Room
Do you want a career in environmental work?
Join us at the PoCSC Symposium for a
light dinner and networking opportunities
within environmental professions. Learn how
these BIPOC owned businesses and local
organizations can be stepping stones in your
early career.
For questions and
accomodations email
pocsc@ucsc.edu
YOU BELONG HERE

difficulty: Stylized handwriting-style font on lined-paper background; photo taken through glass with reflections and tape; QR codes and decorative graphics (star, worm, globe); small print in the 'You Belong Here' badge and logo (not included in full_text, see notes); 'accomodations' is misspelled on the flyer and must stay as printed.
notes: Ground truth leaves out the circular logo text ('People of Color Sustainability Collective') and the tiny badge text ('This opportunity is open to all.' plus an illegible bottom line), and the QR codes at top-left.
